4 اسلبت , said of a she-camel, (S, M, K,) (tropical:) She became deprived of her young one by death (M, K, TA) or by some other means: (M, TA:) or she cast her young one in an imperfect state. (S, M, K.) ―
-b2- اسلب الشَّجَرُ (tropical:) The trees became bare of their fruit, and dropped their leaves. (K, TA.) ―
-b3- اسلب الثُّمَامُ (S, TA) (assumed tropical:) The ثمام [or panic grass] put forth its خُوص [or leaves, so that it became fit to be cut: see سَلَبٌ]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
